name: @tasks/pi-extention

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/index.js --external typebox --external @earendil-works/* --minify && bun build ./src/watch/child-entry.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/watch-child.js --external typebox --minify
